description: Sushi Knowledge progression, daily passive grants and rollover ETA from SushiStuff 1.22 game helpers and the current save
target: Sushi Knowledge bonus and daily progression

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_levels
extractions.description: Current Knowledge level per catalog Sushi (Sushi save row 7, consumed by KnowledgeBonusSpecific)

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_experience
extractions.description: Within-level Knowledge experience per Sushi (Sushi save row 6; daily event adds XP and level-up subtracts the requirement)

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_bonus_specific
extractions.description: Game-computed current per-Sushi Knowledge bonus, including mapped static coefficient, current level, unlock state and tier scaling

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_experience_required
extractions.description: XP needed for each Sushi's current Knowledge level; direct KnowledgeXP_req(level) game helper value

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_passive_slot_inputs
extractions.expression: (() => { const sushi = idleon.getAttr("Sushi"); return Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, slot) => { const tier = Number(sushi[0][slot]); const plate = Number(sushi[1][slot]); return { slot, tier, plate, effect: (plate === 2 || plate === 3) && tier >= 0 ? idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "SlotEffect", plate, 0) : 0, multiplier: (plate === 2 || plate === 3) && tier >= 0 ? idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "KnowledgeXP_multi", slot, 0) : 0 }; }).filter(input => input.tier >= 0 && (input.plate === 2 || input.plate === 3)); })()
extractions.description: Actual occupied Cold/Milktoast source slots plus game helper outputs used as direct parameters of the daily grant; slot index is retained because fireplace modifier is source-slot based

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_bonus_total_1
extractions.description: Aggregate Knowledge bonus category 1, a direct input to KnowledgeXP_multi

extractions.label: sushi_knowledge_upgrade_qty_38
extractions.description: Knowledge XP upgrade quantity 38, a direct input to KnowledgeXP_multi
